content:
Not really. **“System Auto Search” isn’t a common or natural-sounding English phrase** by itself.

People would usually say something like:

- **Automatic search**
- **Auto-search** (often as a feature name)
- **System-wide search** / **search the system automatically** (depending on meaning)
- **Automatic system search** (if you mean the system performs the search automatically)
- **Search automatically** (as a button/setting label)

If you tell me **where it appears** (UI button, menu setting, feature name) and **what it’s supposed to do** (search the computer system? search within an app? search online automatically?), I can suggest the most natural wording.
